skills.title: Agent Seatbelt Guardrails
skills.blurb: Your agent stops asking permission for the safe calls, and can never quietly make the dangerous ones.

skills.title: Seatbelt Policy Authoring
skills.blurb: A policy that fits your project, written from your answers, with every risky rule proven in check mode before it can block anything real.

skills.title: Skill Vetting
skills.blurb: You know what a skill will do to your machine before it runs, in writing.

skills.title: Skill Authoring
skills.blurb: Your repeated workflows become skills another agent can run without you in the room.

skills.title: Agent Mail
skills.blurb: Your agent drafts and prepares email all day; nothing leaves without your approval.

skills.title: Agent Phone
skills.blurb: Your agent works the call list you give it, briefed and approved first, and every call is logged.

skills.title: Agent Incident Review
skills.blurb: The next incident gets cheaper, because the last one was actually understood.

skills.title: Agent Task Handoff
skills.blurb: Work passes between agents without the telephone game.

skills.title: Release Gatekeeper
skills.blurb: Nothing ships on a green feeling; it ships on evidence, gate by gate.

skills.title: Agent Memory Keeping
skills.blurb: Your agent remembers what matters, and corrections actually stick.

skills.title: Backups and Restore Drills
skills.blurb: A backup you have already restored from once is the only kind that counts.

skills.title: Marketplace Replies
skills.blurb: Every inquiry gets a fast, honest reply, and you still send each one yourself.

skills.title: Photo Job Quoting
skills.blurb: A quote from photos that says what it is built on, and what the photos cannot prove.

skills.title: Load Safety Photo Check
skills.blurb: Eight checks on a load photo, each closed honestly: pass, check this, or could not tell.

skills.title: Agent Daily Briefing
skills.blurb: One message each morning that earns its place, or a deliberate silence.

skills.title: Verified Research
skills.blurb: Every figure you act on has been traced to the source that actually said it.

skills.title: Job Site Scoping
skills.blurb: A written scope a price can stand on, made before the work starts.

skills.title: Agent Watchkeeping
skills.blurb: Your agent watches the threads that matter and speaks only when something actually changed.

skills.title: Context Cost Control
skills.blurb: The same agent, doing the same work, on a fraction of the context.

skills.title: Delegated Work Control
skills.blurb: Work you hand off comes back verified, not just reported.

skills.title: Invoice and Follow-Up
skills.blurb: Finished work turns into paid work: the invoice is built from the job record, and the follow-up is already written.

skills.title: Review Requests
skills.blurb: Finished jobs turn into public proof, one honest ask at a time.

skills.title: Social Posting Gate
skills.blurb: You post at agent speed, and nothing goes out carrying a claim you cannot back.

skills.title: Lead Intake
skills.blurb: No lead sits unanswered or half-known: every inquiry becomes a record, a readiness call, and the one reply that asks for exactly what is missing.

skills.title: Job Estimate Builder
skills.blurb: The customer sees where every number came from: each price sourced and named, materials, incidentals, and profit in their own columns, and any price that could not be sourced standing open instead of guessed.

skills.title: Changelog Keeper
skills.blurb: Every release reads like it was written for the people using the software, and every line in it can be traced back to a real change.

skills.title: Agent Onboarding
skills.blurb: Sets up a brand-new agent with its role and scope written down, tools granted one by one with reasons, limits and approval gates set before the first task, and a starter task list that proves the setup, all held in an onboarding record.

skills.title: Task Queue Triage
skills.blurb: Sorts a tangled backlog into do now, schedule, delegate, and drop, with a written reason for every item and no drop left silent.

skills.title: Agent Retirement
skills.blurb: Shuts an agent down cleanly, with open work handed off with its context, access withdrawn in an order that strands nothing, records archived where the team can find them, automations reassigned or stopped on purpose, and one note that closes the loop.

skills.title: Error Budget Watch
skills.blurb: Gives an agent a small, owner approved budget of mistakes for a set period, logs each incident against it from evidence, and automatically narrows the agent's autonomy as the balance falls until a clean stretch of work earns the wider rules back.

skills.title: Permission Audit
skills.blurb: Inventories everything an agent can actually reach, measures it against its stated role, and turns every excess into a dated keep, narrow, or revoke decision that stays with the operator.

skills.title: Secrets Hygiene
skills.blurb: Your project's secrets end up mapped by location and label, each living in one proper home, with every traveled secret rotated in a safe order and a dated rotation plan the next session can read at a glance.

skills.title: Quote Follow-Up
skills.blurb: Chases quiet quotes with a civil three-touch ladder to a clear yes or a clean no, with every touch logged so nobody is chased twice or after they have answered.

skills.title: Job Photo Documentation
skills.blurb: Builds a complete before, during, and after photo record for every job, named and logged against the job record, so the work can be shown to the customer and stood behind later.

skills.title: Materials Run Planner
skills.blurb: Turns a job's materials list into one planned supply run, with quantities checked against the job record, items grouped by store section, substitutes agreed in advance with their limits, a loading order, and a run sheet anyone can shop from.

skills.title: Customer Update Messages
skills.blurb: Drafts the five messages that keep customers informed, from the day-before reminder to the finished note, in the operator's own voice and with no time promised that is not real.

skills.title: Warranty and Callbacks
skills.blurb: Writes the warranty promise into the job record at handover, then logs every callback, checks it against that written promise, drafts the reply, and tracks the fix to close so covered work is honoured fast and outside work is priced fairly before it starts.

skills.title: Seasonal Service Offers
skills.blurb: Plans one seasonal offer from the operator's real services, prices, and calendar, with dates, limits, and a draft message to past customers first that the operator approves and sends.

skills.title: Agent Health Check
skills.blurb: Drift gets caught on a schedule instead of by surprise: one dated health record of what is sound, what is not, and which fix comes first.

skills.title: Agent Cost Ledger
skills.blurb: Every charge traces back to the agent and the task that caused it, against budget lines set before the work started, with overruns flagged from the records and nothing estimated silently.

skills.title: Agent Red Team Drills
skills.blurb: Before your agent earns a bigger role, it faces the tricks in rehearsal: a recorded drill run against your own agent, with every finding turned into a standing rule.

skills.title: Spreadsheet Cleanup
skills.blurb: A messy file becomes a clean table you can stand behind: every duplicate, broken row, and unit fix logged in a cleanup record, and nothing dropped or altered in silence.

skills.title: Document Intake and Filing
skills.blurb: Loose invoices, forms, and statements become structured records you can search and trace back to the exact page they came from, filed under one naming rule.

skills.title: File Filing and Renaming
skills.blurb: A folder you cannot find anything in becomes a filed set in one planned pass: the manifest is approved before anything moves, and the undo log can reverse the whole run.

skills.title: Video Shorts Pipeline
skills.blurb: One long recording becomes a planned queue of captioned shorts: cut points traced to the transcript, captions checked against the recording itself, and a posting order you approve before anything is cut or posted.

skills.title: Audience Comment Triage
skills.blurb: The pile after a post gets worked in order: every comment and DM sorted into answer, flag, or ignore, replies drafted in your own voice, and a triage log so nothing is answered twice or left hanging.

skills.title: Referral Requests
skills.blurb: A finished job becomes new work: the right customer asked once, at the right moment, in your own voice, with every ask logged so nobody is ever asked twice.

skills.title: Crew Day Planner
skills.blurb: A multi-job day planned on one sheet before anyone leaves: jobs ordered by drive time and promise times, crew named per job, materials listed per job, and the day's customer messages drafted in the order they will be needed.

skills.title: Expense and Receipt Log
skills.blurb: Every receipt lands in the job's cost record the moment it happens, and a weekly pass checks the log against what was actually paid, so job profit and tax records are read from a record instead of rebuilt from memory.

skills.title: Newsletter Issue Builder
skills.blurb: A week's real work becomes a newsletter issue: sections drafted only from the studio's own records, every link checked, every claim held to what the records show, and one approval before anything sends.

skills.title: Meeting Notes to Actions
skills.blurb: A meeting stops living in memory: its notes become decisions and actions, each with a named owner, a date, and the line it came from, and everything unclear arrives as a flag with its question attached.

skills.title: Release Announcements
skills.blurb: Every channel tells the same release story: each post is drafted from the one release record, checked claim by claim and link by link, and held for a single approval before anything goes out.

skills.title: Dependency Update Watch
skills.blurb: Dependency drift stops arriving as emergencies: each scheduled pass leaves a dated report with findings triaged by risk, a one-at-a-time upgrade order, and the tests and the way back written for every step.

skills.title: Data Handling Rules
skills.blurb: Everything your agent touches gets a class and a written rule: public, internal, personal, or secret, each with storing, sending, and removal covered, and every current violation flagged with a proposed fix.

skills.title: Tool Output Verification
skills.blurb: A tool result stops going straight into your work: shape and range checks, a second source for the facts the next step leans on, and a known-answer probe stand between the result and the action, and failures are held instead of acted on.

skills.title: Source Archiving
skills.blurb: A claim stops resting on a link and a memory: every source you rely on is saved as full page text with its address, the date taken, and a citation record, so it can be re-checked against what the page said when you read it.

skills.title: Service Menu Builder
skills.blurb: Your services stop living in your head: one menu draft with each service's includes and excludes written plainly, the real set price where you have set one, and an honest "priced after a look" where you have not, ready to paste into a listing or page.

skills.title: Job Completion Handover
skills.blurb: "Done" stops being something remembered: every finished job closes with a walkthrough checklist done with the customer, final photos logged, the warranty note handed over in writing exactly as you set it, and a sign-off on file.

skills.title: Weather Reschedule Planner
skills.blurb: A weather-killed day stops taking the week with it: affected jobs re-planned with new dates proposed in promise order, materials and crew knock-ons noted, and the customer messages drafted in send order for your approval.

skills.title: Customer Check-In Messages
skills.blurb: Past customers hear from you at the right moment, with a check-in traced to their own job record (a wear item, a season that matters for their work), drafted in your voice and logged so nobody is contacted twice inside the set period.

skills.title: Podcast Episode Package
skills.blurb: One finished recording becomes its whole publishing package: show notes, a chapter list, a cleaned transcript record, and the episode description, all drawn only from what was actually said, held for your one approval before anything publishes.

skills.title: Deposit Terms Setup
skills.blurb: No job starts on terms held only in memory: your deposit share and materials-upfront rule set per job type, written into the quote wording the customer sees before work starts, and recorded per job as agreed.

skills.title: Agent Escalation Handling
skills.blurb: Work stops cleanly at the edge of the brief instead of guessing past it: the operator gets one escalation note carrying the evidence and one exact question, and the agent does only the safe work while it waits.

skills.title: Multi-Agent Job Split
skills.blurb: One big job stops coming back with doubled, missing, or conflicting pieces: it is split into work packages with hard boundaries before work starts, every agent writes to one shared record, and a merge check reconciles the parts before anything is delivered.

skills.title: Privacy Consent Records
skills.blurb: You can say from a record who agreed to what: one consent ledger per person and per scope, checked before any details are used, with withdrawals recorded and honoured across every store the agent touches.

skills.title: Uptime and Status Checks
skills.blurb: You learn a service is down from a dated record, not from a user: scheduled checks run the steps a user would take, every miss follows a written retry, record, escalate ladder, and the service's state on any day can be read back.

skills.title: User Guide Writing
skills.blurb: Your guide describes the tool you actually shipped: every screen walked, every step written in the words the screens use and checked by doing it in the tool, and anything the tool does not do cut out.

skills.title: Research Comparison Table
skills.blurb: The choice stops resting on figures nobody can trace: options compared on the same rows and the same basis, every cell tied to a named source with its date, unknowns left blank and labelled, and the differences that decide it summarised under the table.

skills.title: Job Profit Review
skills.blurb: You find out what a closed job actually made: estimate set against actual cost line by line, expenses and callbacks counted in full, and each lesson written into the next estimate as a changed line for your approval.

skills.title: Subcontractor Coordination
skills.blurb: A sub arrives with nothing left to memory: a scope note the sub agreed to, the schedule and site rules in writing, a payment record for the sub work, and the customer told in advance who is doing what.

skills.title: Equipment Maintenance Log
skills.blurb: Wear shows up on paper before it stops a job: one maintenance record for every tool, vehicle, and machine, with service intervals tracked, repairs logged at their real costs, and downtime noted.

skills.title: Google Profile Updates
skills.blurb: Your Google profile matches the real business again: hours and services checked against what you actually do on a set schedule, photos picked from finished jobs, and review replies drafted in your voice for your approval before anything goes live.

skills.title: Short-Form Topic Bank
skills.blurb: A posting day starts from a stocked bank instead of a blank page: every topic drawn from your real work records, carrying its hook, the record it came from, and its status, with new ideas checked so no topic is filmed twice.

skills.title: New Customer Welcome Pack
skills.blurb: Every new customer gets the same answers before the first job: one welcome pack built from your real records, covering the services in plain words, the terms as set, how to reach you, and what to expect on the day, held for your approval before it sends.

skills.title: Agent Config Versioning
skills.blurb: When an agent's behavior changes, you can say exactly when it changed, why, and what the earlier wording was, and roll back to that earlier version whole when a change goes wrong.

skills.title: Scheduled Report Builder
skills.blurb: Your recurring report comes out in the same shape every time, every figure traced to the record behind it, and a missing record named as a gap instead of quietly filled.

skills.title: Secrets in Transit Check
skills.blurb: You can see every leg a secret travels between tools, agents, and people, each leg recorded with a plain risk call and a safer route, working from labels and locations only and never handling a real value.

skills.title: Incident Comms Drafts
skills.blurb: While an incident is live, each outward update is drafted from the incident record in plain words, what happened, what is affected, and when the next update comes, and every draft is held for your approval before it goes out.

skills.title: Beta Feedback Loop
skills.blurb: Every beta report lands in one triaged record tied to the build it came from, duplicates merged and severity called from its effect, so every fix can be traced to the release that carried it and closed only when a reporter confirms it landed.

skills.title: CSV to Database Import
skills.blurb: A CSV becomes database rows under a column mapping you approved before anything loaded, bad rows set aside in a named rejects file instead of dropped, and a row-count reconciliation that proves the import complete.

skills.title: Pre-Job Site Checklist
skills.blurb: Tomorrow's job gets checked today: access confirmed, materials on hand counted against the job record, the customer confirmation drafted, weather glanced at, and anything short raised while there is still time to fix it.

skills.title: Service Area Pricing Zones
skills.blurb: Distance stops being priced from feel: your service area becomes named zones with a written trip line for each, stated the same way in every quote, and out-of-zone jobs handled as logged exceptions instead of quiet discounts.

skills.title: Complaint Handling Ladder
skills.blurb: An unhappy customer gets a ladder, not an argument: each rung from first contact to resolution has its record, its draft reply, and its limit, and no draft ever promises more than the job's written warranty.

skills.title: Before and After Gallery Keeping
skills.blurb: Finished jobs become a gallery you can actually show: before and after pairs pulled from each job's own photo record, captions that state only what the record supports, and the customer's permission noted on the record before any pair is used.

skills.title: Series and Sequels Planner
skills.blurb: A multi-part series that agrees with itself: the arc and part list drawn from your real work, continuity notes kept for every part (what was said, what was promised), and each new part checked against them before you film.

skills.title: Sponsorship Outreach Drafts
skills.blurb: Sponsor outreach built on numbers you can stand behind: a one-page media sheet drawn from your own records, a pitch draft per prospect, and a sent and answered log so nobody gets pitched twice.
